body.summary: An actual-play podcast using Blades in the Dark, set in the city of Marielda in the weeks before the events of the Hieron seasons. A crew of amateur criminals, the Six Fingers of the Hand of the City, are drawn into a scheme to steal the estate of the nobleman Lysander, then into a larger conspiracy involving the cult-like Maelgwyn and the city's founding. The season moves from heist to investigation to a confrontation with the forces behind Marielda's history, ending with ||the crew's actions reshaping the city and setting up the world of Hieron||.

arcs.summary: The Six Fingers plan and execute a heist on Lysander's estate, learning the city's criminal rules along the way.
The crew uncovers a conspiracy tied to Maelgwyn and the city's founding, shifting from thieves to investigators.
The crew confronts the forces behind the conspiracy, and their choices reshape Marielda's future.
